# The Human Decision

## What We Are
The Human Decision is a Human Performance Research Company based in India.
We explore how attention shapes decisions, performance, and outcomes in
modern environments.

## Our Core Belief
Attention is the foundation of human performance. Every decision, every
creative output, every leadership act begins with where and how attention
is directed. In an era of infinite distraction, attention has become the
scarcest and most valuable cognitive resource.

## Our Products

### Attention Health Assessment™
- 88 research-informed questions across 8 dimensions
- Measures: Attentional Control, Executive Function, Working Memory,
  Time Perception, Hyperfocus, Impulse Regulation, Emotional Regulation,
  Recovery Capacity
- Generates: Attention Health Score (0-100), Attention Archetype,
  personalized recommendations, 30-day improvement roadmap
- Duration: 12-15 minutes
- Available at: https://www.thehumandecision.in/assessment

### Human Decision Lab™
- Framework library with original research frameworks
- Newsletter: The Attention Lens (weekly insights)
- Research reports and white papers
- Available at: https://www.thehumandecision.in/lab/frameworks

### Attention Operating System™
- Organizational and team programs
- Founder and leadership attention programs
- Currently in private beta

## The 8 Attention Archetypes
1. Hyperfocused Achiever — Deep focus, inconsistent execution
2. Distracted Performer — High potential, scattered attention
3. Overloaded Founder — Capable but cognitively overwhelmed
4. Burned-Out Operator — Depleted reserves, high drive
5. Reactive Executor — Fast response, low sustained focus
6. Consistent Builder — Steady, reliable, systematic
7. Hidden ADHD Profile — Masked patterns, compensating systems
8. Attention Athlete — Peak attentional performance

## Key Frameworks
- Attention Lifecycle Framework™: Inputs → Attention Engine →
  Deployment → Outcomes → Recovery → back to Inputs
- The Erosion Loop™: Distraction → Fragmented Attention →
  Poor Decisions → Reduced Performance → Stress → Lower Recovery →
  back to Distraction
- The Attention Flywheel™: Better Attention → Better Decisions →
  Better Actions → Better Outcomes → Higher Motivation →
  back to Better Attention
- Human Decision Model™: Attention → Decisions → Performance → Outcomes

## Important Disclaimers
- The Attention Health Assessment™ is NOT a clinical diagnostic tool
- It does NOT diagnose ADHD or any neurological condition
- It measures functional attention patterns in general adult populations
- Users experiencing significant functional impairment should consult
  a qualified healthcare professional
